verdict.rationale: A project-management SaaS could plausibly ship an in-app AI assistant that learns user tone and preferences, so this axis applies. The evidence pack only shows an MCP server, external agent integrations, story templates and workflow automations. None of these is an in-app assistant that learns a user's tone, shorthand or preferences.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have my in-app AI assistant learn my tone, shorthand, and preferences to tailor its output
